description.value:
Starting at 11th level, whenever a creature fails the saving throw of your Destructive Tornado becomes stunned until the end of your next turn.

Foundry note: apply the stunned condition (status effect) to any creature that fails your Destructive Tornado save. With Midi-QOL, you can automate this on the Destructive Tornado item by attaching an Active Effect with the stunned condition and applying it on a failed save.
